[d/g532e4d229a6c-4] decision (cited, source Documentation/READINESS.md@532e4d229a6c)
  Update READINESS with corrected CLI mutant rate of 40.0% and re-measurement details.
  A full sharded re-measurement reproduced the survivor count of 110 but showed the rate is 40.0% of 275 viable, not the previously implied 64.2%. The author updates the record to correct a claim made in the file's own voice and notes the distribution unchanged.

[d/g69ea5c05d859-1] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Accept smysl/1.0 in FORMAT_VERSIONS_SUPPORTED while keeping smysl/0.1.
  The first migration step requires readers to accept both before the writer flips, so old documents keep working and the new version is not refused.

[d/g69ea5c05d859-11] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Update ROAD_TO_1.0.md to mark steps 1 and 2 done, step 3 deferred, and correct the assumption that python/, …
  The plan was wrong about the other three implementations because they only read CBOR and never see a @doc header; the migration is Rust-only and smaller than it looked.

[d/g69ea5c05d859-12] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Update format spec §8.5 to record the version-trap defect as fixed in 0.14.
  -> causes q/g69ea5c05d859-12-1

[d/g69ea5c05d859-14] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Defer flipping the writer default to smysl/1.0 until 0.14 is published.
  §8.2 requires readers to refuse a version absent from their list. Flipping the writer before 0.14 is in the field would make every other implementation reject the output.

[d/g69ea5c05d859-15] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Do not add version lists to python/, nodejs/, go/ implementations.

[d/g69ea5c05d859-6] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Pass the parsed format_version from ParseOutcome to WriteContext in `smysl fmt`.

  Build Constraints via default and field assignment instead of struct literal

[d/g87345653cdf3-8] decision (cited, source scripts/verify-doc-output.py@87345653cdf3)

[d/g90ec2f781421-10] decision (cited, source Documentation/READINESS.md@90ec2f781421)
  Update CHANGELOG, READINESS, and ROAD_TO_1.0 to record dispatch pass findings.
  Document the 15->1 survivor reduction, the seven untested commands, and that dispatch pass is worth stating as finding.
  -> causes q/g90ec2f781421-10-1

[d/g90ec2f781421-12] decision (cited, source Documentation/READINESS.md@90ec2f781421)

  Compare all 380 arguments against a golden CLI surface inside cargo test.

[d/g90ec2f781421-8] decision (cited, source src/main.rs@90ec2f781421)

[d/g90ec2f781421-9] decision (cited, source tests/dispatch.rs@90ec2f781421)

[e/g69ea5c05d859-9-1] evidence (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Check: make ci green

[p/g532e4d229a6c-1-3] constraint (cited, source tests/cmd_fmt.rs@532e4d229a6c)
  The `smysl fmt` command uses exit codes 0, 2, and 3 as defined by the specification.

[p/g532e4d229a6c-4-1] constraint (cited, source Documentation/READINESS.md@532e4d229a6c)
  A full sharded re-measurement confirmed 110 survivors and reproduced the per-file distribution.

[p/g532e4d229a6c-4-2] constraint (cited, source Documentation/READINESS.md@532e4d229a6c)

  -> conditions d/g532e4d229a6c-4

[p/g69ea5c05d859-1-1] constraint (cited, source crates/smysl-core/src/lib.rs@69ea5c05d859)

  -> conditions d/g69ea5c05d859-1

[p/g69ea5c05d859-11-1] constraint (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)

[p/g69ea5c05d859-13-1] constraint (cited, source Documentation/SMYSL_FORMAT_SPEC.md@69ea5c05d859)
  As of 0.14 readers accept both format strings and nothing writes smysl/1.0.

[p/g69ea5c05d859-14-1] constraint (cited, source crates/smysl-core/src/lib.rs@69ea5c05d859)
  §8.2 requires a reader to reject a version absent from its list.
  -> conditions d/g69ea5c05d859-14

  cli+main survivors went from 15 to 1.
  -> conditions d/g90ec2f781421-10

[p/g90ec2f781421-10-2] constraint (cited, source git:90ec2f781421002876548124e9fe02073503372c)

  -> conditions d/g90ec2f781421-10

[q/g69ea5c05d859-12-1] claim (inferred)
  Format spec §8.5 records version-trap defect fixed in 0.14.

[q/g69ea5c05d859-13-1] claim (inferred)
  Format spec §8.6 says smysl/1.0 is not a break; format settled rather than changed.

[q/g87345653cdf3-10-1] claim (inferred)
  Count assertion prevents gate from confusing nothing wrong with nothing checked.

[q/g87345653cdf3-11-1] claim (inferred)
  Compile out doc output test outside default feature set to avoid false drift.

[q/g87345653cdf3-2-1] claim (inferred)
  Remove unused BTreeSet import after replacing struct literal with default construction.

[q/g87345653cdf3-4-1] claim (inferred)
  make ci depends on fuzz-build, so CI gates on fuzz compilation.

[q/g87345653cdf3-6-1] claim (inferred)
  Only compile fuzzers in CI; running remains separate due to nightly and time.

[q/g87345653cdf3-9-1] claim (inferred)
  Adding tests/doc_output.rs exposes replay to cargo test and coverage tools.

[q/g90ec2f781421-10-1] claim (inferred)
  Findings documented: seven untested commands and 15->1 survivor reduction are recorded.

[q/g90ec2f781421-12-1] claim (inferred)
  Doc-output gating remains unchanged; design deliberate.

[q/g90ec2f781421-4-1] claim (inferred)
  Test no longer dirties checkout; each command runs in isolated scratch directory.

[q/g90ec2f781421-7-1] claim (inferred)
  Equivalent `!=` mutant documented instead of chased; records unreachability.

[q/g90ec2f781421-8-1] claim (inferred)
  No pointless test added for unreachable mutation; recorded rather than chased.

[q/ga18e230ae345-3-1] claim (inferred)
  The search test is removed; keeping it would compare two identical configurations.

[q/ga18e230ae345-5-1] claim (inferred)
  A comment in solve.rs documents the removal rationale and measurements.

[q/ga18e230ae345-6-1] claim (inferred)
  Changelog records the removal under Unreleased 0.8.0.

[r/g69ea5c05d859-1-1] claim (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Rejected: Keep the supported list as only 'smysl/0.1' until the writer default flips.
  Readers must accept both before the writer flips so old documents keep working and the new version is not refused.
  -> contrasts d/g69ea5c05d859-1

[r/g69ea5c05d859-13-1] claim (cited, source Documentation/SMYSL_FORMAT_SPEC.md@69ea5c05d859)
  Rejected: Treat smysl/1.0 as a format change or break.
  The version bump signals visibility, not a format change; readers accepted the new string quietly.

[r/g69ea5c05d859-14-1] claim (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Rejected: Flip the writer default to smysl/1.0 immediately.
  §8.2 requires readers to refuse a version absent from their list, so the output would be rejected by other implementations.
  -> contrasts d/g69ea5c05d859-14

[r/g69ea5c05d859-8-1] claim (cited, source crates/smysl-core/src/lib.rs@69ea5c05d859)
  Rejected: Assert a literal list and keep using smysl/1.0 as an unknown version.
  The old test would fail on new versions or silently pass on unlisted additions.
